jobs.brief: STAGE 1 — INTAKE CATWALK. A long-abandoned material receiving bay at the edge of the foundry. At far left, a modest narrow maintenance niche with one hooded amber lamp and a closed dented tool locker suggests former human workers, not a house. Behind the quiet combat band are broad low stacks of empty iron mold trays and a stalled conveyor, deliberately sparse. A giant freight cage and hanging lift chain appear in the middle distance at center-left, supported by dark tower pillars receding into blue-gray haze. Coldest and most spacious of the three regions, faint dusty brass rail hardware, restrained rust only in a few grouped patches. Industrial scale, desolate but one tiny human warmth.
jobs.prompt:
Create one production pixel-art BATTLE BACKGROUND for ORVASK, a dystopian enormous industrial tower. Reference image 1 is the approved world-art style, broad flat pixel clusters, atmospheric architectural depth, low surface detail, muted blue gray green metal and very small warm light. Reference image 2 shows the ACTUAL narrow battle viewport and actors for composition only. DO NOT copy any actors, lettering, numbers, HUD, frames, or markers from reference 2.
New setting: the enclosed FOUNDRY district, no outside city and no sky. This must look like a different place from the residential district yet use exactly its quiet painterly pixel masses and selective stepped edges. Not glossy concept art, not tiny tiled detail, no heavy black outline, no dithering, no scattered spark particles. Broad coherent 5–10 pixel-looking steps on a roughly 1672x941 wide 16:9 canvas. Softness comes from large clusters and grouped values, NEVER optical blur.
Functional composition LOCK: one continuous straight SIDE-ON steel catwalk across the entire width, with its top foot-contact line precisely at 76% of image height. No perspective slope, stairs, gaps or protruding props on this combat plane. Thin subdued rail BEHIND this platform, no taller than 4% of image height above foot line. Dark structural beams below platform, spanning bottom. Every part of platform must be grounded and continuous. The game crops to the lower-middle band (approximately y46%–87%) and places small player at x10%, four enemies across x45%–96%. Put the area's recognisable architecture also in that visible band. Avoid a canopy or bright bright panel behind the player. Keep x40%–96%, y47%–75% relatively quiet mid-dark teal/gray masses so rusty bronze enemies and pale HP text remain clearly visible. All warm foundry heat is deep BEHIND this plane and limited to small dim amber/rust shapes, no white-hot pools/foreground fire. A faintly lighter desaturated atmospheric layer separates actors from distant construction. The enormous height is felt through receding columns and a vertical shaft. No hero, people, creatures, statues, robots or weapons in background. No title, labels, letters, UI, icons or watermark. Output the whole background, opaque.

jobs.brief: STAGE 2 — PRESSURE AND MOLD WORKSHOP. Deep in the tower's casting works: giant bowed pressure conduits, a pair of broad vertical piston presses, closed suspended mold boxes on a high gantry. Their silhouettes descend into the visible lower-middle band, but remain behind the combat rail. One broad muted brass pressure-pipe elbow and a small recessed furnace inspection slit provide distinct warm shapes at left-center, no distributed lights. Dense enormous equipment arranged in three depth planes, mostly cool desaturated slate gray, charcoal teal, soot brown. Distinguish this from a warehouse through the huge presses and pressure pipe loops. No diagonal floor, no foreground machinery blocking the continuous catwalk. No cozy residential hut.

jobs.brief: STAGE 3 — GREAT FURNACE REGULATOR. The heart of the foundry inside the enormous tower. A monumental cylindrical furnace and one very large vertical regulator wheel/ratchet behind it dominate center-left to center, viewed straight from the side across a shaft. A restrained deep amber furnace seam and dim reflected rust occupy a small region of this background monument, NOT a bright sun or circular portal. Ribbed steel pillars and oversized locking braces surround the vessel; farther right receding smoke-gray support plates remain quiet for the boss silhouette and HP. High, oppressive, abandoned authority, traces of an obsolete labor control station at far left. Make the lower-middle composition readable when cropped; the large furnace lower housing remains visible above platform. The strongest warm material of the three stages but still mostly cold slate/teal and dark iron. No flames, lava river, sky, people, glowing magic, ornate fantasy architecture.
